title: He left Chandigarh at 19 for a Canadian university. In 2026, he became Canada's Ambassador to the UAE.

sources.text: Free Press Journal - Who Is Angad Singh Dhillon? Indian-Origin Canadian Adviser Named Ambassador To UAE
Outlook India - Who Is Angad Singh Dhillon? Indian-Origin Man Appointed As Canada's Ambassador To UAE

caption:
He left Chandigarh at 19 for a Canadian university. In 2026, he became Canada's Ambassador to the UAE.

Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand announced the appointment, with Dhillon succeeding Radha Krishna Panday as Canada's top diplomat in Abu Dhabi.

He built his career inside Canada's federal government and the Prime Minister's Office - starting as a 2015 campaign organizer, rising to Chief of Staff for two cabinet ministers, then directing investment-file operations in the PMO.

Dhillon's rise from a Punjab classroom to a Canadian ambassadorship is one more thread in a growing web of Indian-origin officials now shaping how the world's governments deal with each other.
